_comment: Dataset sintetico per test adapter YouTube Music / Google Takeout (Story 1.1, Sessione 42). Copre i 12 casi minimi della spec 03-ADAPTERS/youtube-music.md par.8: happy path, idempotenza, E6 (topic channel, VEVO, products), E.YT.2 (video rimossi), E.YT.3 (prefisso localizzato), E.YT.5 (durata assente), E.YT.6 (duplicati cross-export), E10 (fusi orari), privacy (locationInfos), DEDUP (bucket 0). 13 eventi: 9 importati, 4 scartati.

_metadata.format: Google Takeout 'YouTube and YouTube Music' -> history/watch-history.json
_metadata.expectedDedupRules: 02-DATA-SCHEMA par.5: DEDUP-3 fuzzy:<sha1(normalize(name)+'|'+normalize(artistPrincipal)+'|'+durationBucketMs)>; durationBucketMs = floor(durationMs/2000)*2000. Per YouTube durationMs e' sempre 0 (E.YT.5) quindi bucket 0: il bucket non discrimina (degradazione dichiarata par.6).

_expectedOutput._comment: Derivazione interna come canone (casi par.8). eventKey = 'youtube_music:' + sha1(videoId + '|' + time).
_expectedOutput._skippedNonMusicDerivation: event E6_non_music_tech (header 'YouTube' + canale generico, euristica 2e) -> warning nonMusicSkipped
_expectedOutput._skippedUnwatchableDerivation: event E_YT2_removed_video (title 'Watched <url>' senza titleUrl ne' subtitles, E.YT.2) -> warning unwatchableSkipped
_expectedOutput._skippedNonListenDerivation: event non_listen_liked + non_listen_search (par.3.3 regola 3: skip silenzioso, nessun warning)
_expectedOutput._uniqueTracksDerivation: 9 eventi importati - 1 merge DEDUP-3 (E6_topic_channel + E6_music_via_header_dedup, stesso name+artist, bucket 0) = 8 Track unici
_expectedOutput._dedupAppliedDerivation: La coppia DEDUP e' unita in 1 Track (videoId diversi, 2 ListenEvent); Artist.platformIds.youtube_music = 'UC_dedup' (par.3.1.2)
